relations.subject: Janet Gyatso

relations.subject: Janet Gyatso
relations.role: Hershey Professor of Buddhist Studies and the Associate Dean for Faculty and Academic Affairs
relations.evidence: Gyatso currently teaches at Harvard Divinity School and has taught with Harvard since 2001. She is the first Hershey Professor of Buddhist Studies at Harvard's Divinity School

relations.subject: Janet Gyatso
relations.evidence: Prior to teaching at Harvard, Gyatso taught at Amherst College (between 1987 and 2001)

relations.subject: Janet Gyatso
relations.evidence: From 2000 to 2006, Gyatso held the position of president of the International Association of Tibetan Studies.

relations.subject: Janet Gyatso
relations.object: Buddhism Section of the American Academy of Religion
relations.evidence: From 2004 to 2010, she was co-chair of the Buddhism Section of the American Academy of Religion.
